turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him before they did.
I'm waiting. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone call me before it went into the gradebook?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Save it. Owen found out from his phone, in the middle of class, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
I don't give blessings, and I don't hand out trust before I've seen anything. What is "my way", exactly, and what do you have besides a number from a program?
